svg.title: One token's life
svg.desc: One token's life, top to bottom: on the host, the Eval-Apply Generalized Interpreter's evaluator walks the model's program a form at a time (generate, a token's position, every layer this machine runs, then the sampler), and each verb launches its arithmetic on the worker that holds the data. On the card, worker 0, through a silicon family: the token's embedding read from a table in RAM, the rotary angles, the DeltaNet or attention mixer, the router, the layer's close, the final norm and the logits, and the sampler's repetition penalty, temperature, top k and draw. On a CPU socket, worker 1, through x86_avx2: the routed experts, sys__scheduler__add handing it a frozen program, the picture xq, whose answer the card waits on with sys__wait_for_result and copies across. Only the token comes back to the host, each the next one's input, until an end token.
